title: US-04 DFD: add a fridge ingredient

flows.label: Owned ingredient id/name and server addedAt

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
Blank trimmed names produce 400 without an inventory write. Nonblank names receive a server id and UTC addedAt.
addedAt is addition time, never expiry or freshness. No quantity arithmetic is modeled; repeated inventory names are not silently deduplicated.
